race.comment: HEADHUNTER (11) doesn't win out of turn but has been knocking on the door throughout this prep and possesses a sharp turn of foot. His last win came over this track and trip back in January. If he's not too far off them at the turn, he can finish over the top. CELESTIAL BLAZE (6) has a lot more tactical speed than those two and should be able to spear across from his middle draw to be handy. Is yet to prove himself at the mile, but if he gets an easy time of it in front he can go on with the job. TORO STRIKE (9) has been in good touch in his last three and gets an identical set-up, though he will need Thompson on top of his game from out there. DON'TCHA THINK (7) will likely inject a bit of speed into the race and deserves consideration on recent efforts.
